title: Pushing JWST to the extremes: Search and scrutiny of bright galaxy candidates at z ≃ 15─30
question: Investigate the galaxy UV Luminosity Function at zsimeq15-30 by selecting and scrutinizing bright galaxy candidates and characterizing lower-redshift interlopers.

what.value: ASTRODEEP-JWST multi-band photometric catalogs of 531173 objects across seven fields

evidence.quote: We used JWST and HST photometric measurements from the ASTRODEEP-JWST catalogs presented in M24.
The seven fields comprise a total of 531173 objects in an area of $\sim$615 sq. arcmin, making the ASTRODEEP-JWST the largest publicly released JWST catalogs available to date.

what.value: Lensing magnification model for the Abell 2744 cluster field

evidence.quote: in the case of A2744, which is affected by lensing, we adopt the approach in Eq. 1 of (cite: Castellano2023a), namely the effective volumes in each bin are obtained by taking into account the area at different magnification levels computed on the basis of the model by (cite: Bergamini2022)

recipe.goal: Design and apply Lyman-break color selection criteria for z ~ 15-20 and z ~ 20-28 candidates
recipe.method: Test color cuts on EGG and JAGUAR mock catalogs perturbed with observational noise, then apply SNR and color thresholds to the ASTRODEEP-JWST multi-band catalogs and HST stacks
key_parameters: SNR > 10 in F356W+F444W detection band; SNR < 2.0 in bands blueward of the break; (F200W-F277W) > 1.5 for z~15-20; (F277W-F356W) > 1.5 for z~20-28
assumptions: z = 18 assumed to convert observed F277W magnitude to rest-frame M_UV for the 5 F200W-dropout candidates

recipe.goal: Compute photometric redshift probability distributions P(z) and evaluate low-z interloper solutions
recipe.method: Multi-wavelength SED fitting using four independent codes across eight configurations
key_parameters: BAGPIPES live points increased from 400 to 2000, ionization parameter up to log U = -1
assumptions: Chabrier (2003) IMF (or BPASS IMF cutoff 300 M_sun in BAGPIPES), Calzetti (2000) attenuation law, flat LambdaCDM (H0=70, Omega_M=0.30)

recipe.goal: Spectroscopically confirm and characterize F200W-dropout interlopers including ALMA 870 um continuum analysis of UDS_56824
recipe.method: Reduce CAPERS NIRSpec PRISM spectra, measure emission line fluxes with Gaussian fits, image archival ALMA Band 7 continuum data for UDS_56824, and perform constrained SED fitting and dust mass estimation
key_parameters: Natural weighting and uvtaper tested in tclean; A_V constrained between 1.8 and 5 in BAGPIPES energy-balance fit for UDS_56824
assumptions: Dust opacity kappa_450um = 0.13 m^2 kg^-1, dust temperature T_d = 25 K (also tested T_d = 50 K), and dust emissivity index beta_dust = 1.8

recipe.goal: Compute the binned UV Luminosity Function at z = 15-20 and z = 20-30 and compare with theoretical models
recipe.method: Inject 2.5e5 mock galaxies into blank image regions to measure completeness and effective volume per field, then evaluate binned UV LF under Case 1 (all candidates real) and Case 2 (all candidates interlopers)
key_parameters: 500 mock objects inserted per simulation run; Sersic index n = 1, fixed half-light radius R_h = 0.2 kpc; lensing magnification mu < 5 in A2744
assumptions: Small number Poisson statistics (Gehrels 1986) for 1-sigma upper limits

answer_key.quantity: ALMA 870 um integrated flux density of UDS_56824

evidence.quote: A $\sim$3$\sigma$ detection is found at the NIRCam position of UDS_56824, with an integrated flux density of $S_{870_{\rm \mu m}}=0.54 \pm 0.19\,$mJy (see Fig. 6).
The redshift can be accurately measured to be $z_{spec}$=6.56$\pm$0.01 from the H$\alpha$, H$\beta$, \[O III\]$\lambda_{4959,5007}$ lines

answer_key.quantity: Dust mass of UDS_56824 (assuming T_d = 25 K)

evidence.quote: This yields a dust mass of $\sim$5.5$\times 10^8\,$M$_{\odot}$, close to 10% of the stellar mass - a remarkably high value given the redshift of the galaxy.

score_reason: The primary photometric catalogs (ASTRODEEP-JWST) and ALMA archival dataset (2015.1.01074.S) are public, and color selection equations, SED-fitting configurations, and target coordinates are thoroughly documented. Minor imaging details for the ALMA continuum map (exact uvtaper, beam size) and the completeness simulation grids are not explicitly tabulated.
rediscovery_reason: The ASTRODEEP-JWST catalogs and ALMA project 2015.1.01074.S are public, the color selection criteria are given as explicit algebraic cuts, and both the candidate properties and the ALMA 870 um flux density of UDS_56824 are quantitative answer keys.
